name: standmeet-group-compose
description: The group-composition acceptance test: two minimal cordis blocks (group-provider provides demoBase; group-consumer injects demoBase and derives demoDerived) composed by a cordis:group. Proves dsh loads a composed block group and resolves provide/inject by dependency (not list order) on a real DSH — the composition the single-block gates do not exercise. Exports the two blocks as subpaths so the group entries resolve them by name.
